recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5632 unless Patient Care reopens the later ClinicalAssessment/ClinicalImpression naming decision.
issue_request: FHIR-5632 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and requested renaming the Clinical Assessment resource to Clinical Impression to avoid confusion with assessment instruments and emphasize the assessment-process outcome.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite svn revision 4745, represented in git by 81d1bff591ce339694764d726741b17b6770fe00, whose message includes '#5632 - rename ClinicalAssessment to clinicalimpression' and which added the ClinicalImpression source tree. Later source history removed the old clinicalassessment folder and kept a historical fhir.ini note that Clinical Assessment became ClinicalImpression.
additional_context: FHIR-46596 is a later Applied/Persuasive R6 decision to rename ClinicalImpression back to ClinicalAssessment. That reverse rename was applied by J#46596/PR #3441, and the combined branch already contains c2ae6dad7eeae9e6652fcd5dff5e19f6159bdd3d for Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-46596 to finish active current-page references. Current fhir.ini active resources include neither ClinicalImpression nor ClinicalAssessment, and active narrative points ClinicalAssessment to the Patient Care incubator.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Re-applying the DSTU1 ClinicalImpression name would contradict the later final FHIR-46596 decision and current out-of-core source scope.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied/Persuasive R6 decision reversed the DSTU1 ClinicalImpression naming decision and is already represented on the combined branch.
